title: Line-Plan Credit on Late-Billed Rental Installments
content:
A late-billed Rental Property Service Contracts monthly installment carries a line-plan credit read from the landlord's Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans holdings.

| Active utility line protection plan held by the landlord | Premium payments posted on the landlord's line plans in the 12 months before the installment is billed | Line-plan credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 0.02 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | 0.01 |
| no | any | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Utility Line Protection Plans records: the landlord's line plans and their status, and the premium payments posted on them, with their dates.

**How the rate acts.** The credit rates on a late-billed installment are added together and subtracted from one, and the installment is multiplied once by that sum.

*Hypothetical:* an active line plan with 7 payments posted in the 12 months: 0.01.
